metadata.database: A Deeper China | Chongqing point decision layer

CQ001.guest_value: Give the first-time visitor a civic and time reference before the city’s vertical layers.
CQ001.choose_rule: Use as a short orientation stop, not as a CBD shopping objective.
CQ001.stop_after: The guest understands the monument, road directions and current centre relationship.

CQ002.guest_value: Show a working temple pocket inside the high-density centre.
CQ002.choose_rule: Use when religion, architecture or public-life contrast is an explicit interest; explain etiquette first.
CQ002.stop_after: The guest has noticed the sound, light and pace change across the temple gate.

CQ003.guest_value: Let the guest test the multiple-ground phenomenon rather than receive a cyberpunk slogan.
CQ003.choose_rule: Use once and keep the experiment bounded; no exposed-edge approach is needed.
CQ003.stop_after: The predicted level and the actual level have been reconciled.

CQ004.guest_value: Explain why Chongqing grew at this peninsula and river junction.
CQ004.choose_rule: Use before adding another skyline viewpoint.
CQ004.stop_after: The guest can reconstruct the two rivers and peninsula direction.

CQ005.guest_value: Use Hongya Cave as a layered visual object while separating reconstruction, branding and commerce.
CQ005.choose_rule: Read the exterior and limit interior commercial wandering.
CQ005.stop_after: The guest can see the bridge, cliff, river and building layers together.

CQ006.guest_value: Provide an outside-in reading of Hongya Cave and the river system.
CQ006.choose_rule: Prefer this over entering a crowded complex when the goal is visual geography.
CQ006.stop_after: The guest has a legible cross-river diagram and a safe return route.

CQ007.guest_value: Frame a current city-branding event as governance and public-space organisation, not history.
CQ007.choose_rule: Only include with an official date-specific notice; otherwise use ordinary night reading.
CQ007.stop_after: The event’s public-space and crowd-management pattern has been observed.

CQ008.guest_value: Explain guild networks, migration and urban commerce through one place.
CQ008.choose_rule: Use as the indoor/history anchor before the gate or street extension.
CQ008.stop_after: The guest can name one guild function beyond decorative heritage.

CQ009.guest_value: Make the old city’s water-gate terrain visible in the physical wall and slope.
CQ009.choose_rule: Pair with CQ008 only if surfaces and stairs remain comfortable.
CQ009.stop_after: The guest sees how gate, wall, river and slope form one defence system.

CQ010.guest_value: Read trade, finance and opening history in the lower city.
CQ010.choose_rule: Use for architecture/history visitors; distinguish original fabric from new commercial work.
CQ010.stop_after: The guest identifies at least one historical layer and one current-use layer.

CQ016.guest_value: Provide an indoor economic-history supplement when the street sequence needs context or rain cover.
CQ016.choose_rule: Choose instead of adding another street, not in addition by default.
CQ016.stop_after: The museum has answered the selected trade/finance question.

CQ011.guest_value: Teach the difference between public circulation and residents’ private life.
CQ011.choose_rule: Use only on confirmed public passages; no interior access or staged resident encounter.
CQ011.stop_after: The guest has understood the transport/residential overlap without intrusion.

CQ012.guest_value: Show the land entrance and old-city boundary as terrain infrastructure.
CQ012.choose_rule: Use as a short historical anchor before any longer trail.
CQ012.stop_after: The guest can relate the gate to slope, wall and movement.

CQ013.guest_value: Let the guest understand mountain-city movement through feet and thresholds.
CQ013.choose_rule: Use only when fitness, weather and a pre-set turnaround are acceptable.
CQ013.stop_after: The chosen segment has answered the terrain question; do not finish it for distance alone.

CQ014.guest_value: Compare living/updated old-city form without making the district a shopping circuit.
CQ014.choose_rule: Include only when already on the route and the comparison adds a new question.
CQ014.stop_after: The guest can distinguish continuity, reconstruction and commercial renewal.

CQ015.guest_value: Offer a focused civilian-war-memory layer with emotional pacing.
CQ015.choose_rule: Use when history is explicit; give a content warning and quiet exit.
CQ015.stop_after: The guest has a grounded historical frame and time to recover.

CQ038.guest_value: Turn hotpot into ordering, spice and social-rhythm learning rather than a restaurant recommendation.
CQ038.choose_rule: Only use after dietary, hygiene, price, language and supplier gates are passed.
CQ038.stop_after: One safe, understood meal is complete; no food crawl.

CQ039.guest_value: Use breakfast timing and ordering to enter everyday food culture at low cost.
CQ039.choose_rule: No specific shop or price before field and dietary checks.
CQ039.stop_after: One ordering or timing pattern is understood and the guest has eaten safely.

CQ017.guest_value: Build a city framework for Ba-Yu, Three Gorges, war and migration histories.
CQ017.choose_rule: Use one selected question and leave processing time; do not treat size as depth.
CQ017.stop_after: The guest can state three observations that changed their Chongqing model.

CQ018.guest_value: Connect the museum to the civic axis without adding another full attraction.
CQ018.choose_rule: Use only as a short exterior comparison when already nearby.
CQ018.stop_after: The city-axis relationship is clear; stop before architectural collecting.

CQ019.guest_value: Place the wartime capital in a walkable residential and political landscape.
CQ019.choose_rule: Use when history/architecture matters; avoid combining with every war museum.
CQ019.stop_after: The guest can compare domestic scale with international political function.

CQ020.guest_value: Give foreign visitors an accessible but nuanced interface to wartime cooperation.
CQ020.choose_rule: Use for explicit international/WWII interest and allow time for competing narratives.
CQ020.stop_after: The guest can name one cooperation and one tension in the story.

CQ021.guest_value: Explain the rail line as a working transport system before taking the famous photo.
CQ021.choose_rule: Use the ride-and-viewpoint pair only when service and crowd conditions are current.
CQ021.stop_after: The relationship between train, river edge and different grounds is clear.

CQ022.guest_value: Offer an external view of the train/terrain relationship with a strict time limit.
CQ022.choose_rule: Use only after the ride or if the guest’s question is visual rather than transit-led.
CQ022.stop_after: One train/terrain relationship is seen; no guaranteed train or photo moment.

CQ023.guest_value: Use elevation to review rivers, bridges and ridges already experienced.
CQ023.choose_rule: Choose only when weather visibility and height tolerance support synthesis.
CQ023.stop_after: The guest can point to prior route geography and stops before a photo queue takes over.

CQ024.guest_value: Add an industrial-reuse comparison to the elevated-city reading.
CQ024.choose_rule: Use only when a current programme or open public space gives it a real question.
CQ024.stop_after: One reuse choice is understood; do not add a generic creative-district crawl.

CQ040.guest_value: Offer one understandable structure of voice, face, movement or music.
CQ040.choose_rule: Only after programme, language, seating, price, cancellation and supplier gates pass.
CQ040.stop_after: The guest can identify one performance structure and has a clear return plan.

CQ025.guest_value: Ground the 1891 opening story in actual buildings and river orientation.
CQ025.choose_rule: Use as the first south-bank history anchor, not a generic park stop.
CQ025.stop_after: One building’s relationship with river transport is clear.

CQ026.guest_value: Close the opening story through lanes, buildings and current renewal.
CQ026.choose_rule: Use only while the route remains public, coherent and physically comfortable.
CQ026.stop_after: The guest can connect opening history, street form and current reuse.

CQ027.guest_value: Provide a genuine mountain-city movement experience with an honest physical boundary.
CQ027.choose_rule: Use only after fitness, footing, shade and return plan are confirmed.
CQ027.stop_after: The pre-set turnaround is reached before safety or return risk rises.

CQ028.guest_value: Add a village/street context to the trail only when it improves the terrain story.
CQ028.choose_rule: Do not add as a separate attraction after a demanding descent.
CQ028.stop_after: The trail’s recovery node and built context are understood.

CQ029.guest_value: Read how academy, artists and neighbourhood surface meet without claiming private access.
CQ029.choose_rule: Use one bounded public section and avoid treating every mural as community evidence.
CQ029.stop_after: Four visible producers or layers are identified without entering private space.

CQ031.guest_value: Offer an art-focused branch when current campus/public access and guest intent align.
CQ031.choose_rule: Choose instead of extending the street indefinitely; no assumed campus access.

CQ030.guest_value: Observe tea-house seating, pace and public interaction before any participation.
CQ030.choose_rule: No candid portraits, staged introductions or payment promise without consent and supplier gates.
CQ030.stop_after: The guest has observed first; any photograph or interaction follows explicit consent.

CQ032.guest_value: Compare industrial space, air-raid history and museum display as different time layers.
CQ032.choose_rule: Choose one question and stop before turning the cluster into a museum marathon.

CQ033.guest_value: Offer a short vertical-public-transport experiment for the right guest.
CQ033.choose_rule: Use only when the route question is transport/verticality and access is current.
CQ033.stop_after: The vertical movement has been experienced once; do not add as a novelty loop.

CQ034.guest_value: Use the ropeway only when queue, weather and return route make it worthwhile.
CQ034.choose_rule: Choose over the cruise, not in addition to it, unless the guest explicitly accepts the wait.
CQ034.stop_after: One moving river perspective is enough.

CQ035.guest_value: Use the cruise as a lower-walking river view when the operator and weather fit.
CQ035.choose_rule: Choose over the ropeway and never promise a particular skyline condition.
CQ035.stop_after: The guest has read one moving river sequence and returns safely.

CQ037.guest_value: Observe contemporary young-city consumption without claiming private access or insider status.
CQ037.choose_rule: Use one connected public edge and define the latest safe return time.
CQ037.stop_after: One difference in people, price or pace is understood.

CQ036.guest_value: Offer a targeted heritage, craft or family layer only when it answers a specific question.
CQ036.choose_rule: Use early and selectively; do not add it as a generic old-town or shopping stop.
CQ036.stop_after: The chosen non-commercial or family question is answered before the main commercial street dominates.
